title_yt: The GTA 6 sick day costs more than 3 games #Shorts
title_fb: The GTA 6 sick day costs more than three games
hook: If you fake sick for G T A six, is it free?
open_loop: Hook asks 'is it free?' and withholds the answer. Coins drain on the couch; 'more than three games' and the $247 are revealed only in lines 4-5 (last ~10 s).
payoff: Pay stub -$247 vs generic $79.99 boxes: more than three games. Playing after work costs $0 extra.

lines.text: If you fake sick for GTA 6, is it free?
lines.say: If you fake sick for G T A six, is it free?
lines.visual: Benny in office shirt and tie at desk, phone to ear, fist-cough. Hooded stranger (boss) behind him, arms crossed. Headline 'GTA 6 SICK DAY'. Then a big gold '$0?' stamp slams in on 'free', with three unlabeled gray mystery boxes with '?' in the corner.

lines.text: You fake a cough. Your boss looks suspicious.
lines.visual: Benny coughs, smug. Boss stranger squints, leans in, then shrugs 'okay'. Benny throws the tie away, hoodie on.

lines.text: Now you relax, and you lose money every hour.
lines.visual: Benny in hoodie on a couch with a plain controller silhouette and snacks. Coin pile under his feet; coins slide away. Wall clock ticks. Badge 'HOUR 3'.

lines.text: At typical pay, an unpaid day costs about $247.
lines.say: At typical pay, an unpaid day costs about two hundred fifty dollars.
lines.visual: Pay stub slaps onto Benny's face, counter drops to -$247. Badge 'TYPICAL PAY, 40 H, UNPAID'. His grin freezes.

lines.text: That is more than three whole games!
lines.visual: Three plain gray generic boxes (no art, no logo), each tagged '$79.99', drop one by one on sleeping/frozen Benny and bury him (thud sfx). Snap-zoom on 'three'. Pay stub shrinks.

lines.text: Play after work, and it costs nothing extra.
lines.visual: Boxes vanish. Benny at night in hoodie, happy, coins intact. Badge '$0 EXTRA'. Small confetti.

lines.text: Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: Split frame: left Benny coughing with row 'A: SICK', right Benny smug at night with row 'B: AFTER WORK'. Benny points at viewer.

facts_used.claim: US median usual weekly earnings of full-time workers Q1 2026 = $1,235; full time = 35+ h/week (40 h used as an example).
GTA 6 Standard Edition price $79.99; release Nov 19, 2026.
'GTA Flu' = launch-week meme of faking sick days (no stats used).

upload.title: The GTA 6 sick day costs more than 3 games #Shorts
upload.description:
Is a fake sick day really free? Do the math first.
Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
If the day is unpaid, the typical US full-time worker (40 hours a week) loses about $247. A new game costs $79.99, so that is more than three games.
Not financial advice. Many jobs offer paid sick leave. Pay data: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (median weekly earnings).
#gta6 #money #savingmoney #Shorts

changes_from_previous: (1) Hook now 12 words, a question that withholds the number; 'more than three games' is first said in line 5 as the twist, with a boxes-bury-Benny gag. (2) 'average' replaced by 'typical' in speech, badge and description. (3) Line 2 adds the boss's suspicious look; line 3 is literal ('lose money every hour'). (4) On-screen text all <=5 words (ending rows A: SICK / B: AFTER WORK). (5) Upload says 'more than three games' and 'typical US full-time worker'. Payoff line has a vanishing-boxes gag.
